About the College
Dibrugarh town has a glorious background in the history of women’s education in N. E. India. It was in Dibrugarh that the first Girls’ High School was established in Assam in the year 1885, which is now known as Dibrugarh Govt. Girls’ Higher Secondary and Multi – Purpose school. Before the establishment of this school, girls had to go outside Assa…

Message from Principal
It is a pleasure to welcome you to MDKG College, a premier institution for women’s education in Assam, founded in 1963. Since its inception, the college has provided quality Arts education, and in 2016, we introduced the Science section with a vision to expedite the scientific temperament among the girls.
